title: [Inside the Nest]
description: Surrounded by tightly woven sticks and broken tree limbs reinforced with a dense concoction of mud and rotten vegetation, even the smallest amount of movement is a deafening alarm to the presence of an intruder.  Bright crimson blotches disfigure the powder blue feathers that litter the roost, and a nauseating aroma rises from the avian bed, stealing all the existing fresh air.  Knee-high edges make this a formidable nest, but numerous gaps in the avian dwelling make for an easy escape.
